name: Remote MCP with Azure Functions
description: A quickstart template for building and deploying secure, remote MCP servers to the cloud using Azure Functions and Node.js/TypeScript. It features integrated blob storage for snippet management and supports advanced security options like OAuth and VNET isolation.
